posts.title: 1940s: Don't be a Fuel Hog!
posts.description: Found this poster while looking through a collection of British WWII posters. Not much information to go on this one. I can't see an artist credit nor date of printing. Just a note its the property of the Ministry of Fuel and Power and was printed by the Stationary Office. posts.title: A Bastille Day Mystery
posts.description: Today is Bastille Day, the official commemoration of the French Revolution (the one with Napoleon and Guillotines). I've seen quite a few peices of art dedicated to it. Most I've seen before, but the painting above is new to me. I find it quite striking and energetic so thought I would make it the centre piece for a short post marking the occasion with some public domain art inspired by it. Howeve
